---
title: "Data Quality Notes"
format: gfm
execute:
  echo: false
  warning: false
---

```{r}
#| label: setup
library(dplyr)

df    <- readRDS("processed/course_offerings.RDS")
plans <- readRDS("processed/course_plans.RDS")

summary_tbl <- df |>
  group_by(institution) |>
  summarise(
    Rows         = n(),
    Codes        = n_distinct(course_code_raw),
    year_min     = min(year),
    year_max     = max(year),
    `Extracted OK`= sum(has_extracted_text),
    has_plan_id  = sum(!is.na(plan_content_id)),
    `Median chars` = round(median(extracted_text_nchar[has_extracted_text], na.rm = TRUE)),
    `Unique plans` = n_distinct(plan_content_id, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    Years     = ifelse(year_min == year_max, as.character(year_min), paste0(year_min, "-", year_max)),
    Rate      = sprintf("%.1f%%", `Extracted OK` / Rows * 100),
    `Dedup %` = sprintf("%.1f%%", (1 - `Unique plans` / has_plan_id) * 100)
  ) |>
  select(Institution = institution, Rows, Codes, Years,
         `Extracted OK`, Rate, `Median chars`, `Unique plans`, `Dedup %`)

total_rows     <- nrow(df)
total_text <- sum(df$has_extracted_text)
total_rate     <- sprintf("%.1f%%", total_text / total_rows * 100)
total_plans    <- nrow(plans)
single_year    <- sort(unique(df$institution[ave(df$year, df$institution, FUN = function(y) length(unique(y))) == 1]))
```

Generated: `r Sys.Date()`

## Overview

```{r}
#| label: summary-table
knitr::kable(summary_tbl)
```

**Total**: `r total_rows` rows, `r total_text` with extracted text (`r total_rate`), `r total_plans` unique plans.

**Columns:**

- **Rows**: Total course-semester rows in harvested data (from DBH)
- **Codes**: Unique course codes (course_code_raw)
- **Extracted OK**: Rows with successfully extracted course plan text
- **Rate**: Extraction success rate (Extracted OK / Rows)
- **Median chars**: Median character count of extracted text
- **Unique plans**: Distinct course plans after normalization and deduplication
- **Dedup %**: Percentage of rows removed by deduplication (1 - unique/has_plan)

## Year coverage

Sites that show only the plan in force (`plan_years = "current"` in
`R/institution_config.R`) give, at each harvest, the plan of that academic
year only. Each harvest is kept, and an offering gets the plan from a harvest
made in its own academic year, or none (README "Sites that show only the
current plan"). In this data the harvests are of 2026-04-04 (2025/26:
autumn 2025 offerings) and 2026-09-30 (2026/27: no DBH offerings yet), so
spring 2025 offerings (2024/25) have no plan at these sites. They are
`r paste(single_year, collapse = ", ")`.
The others have historical plans as far back as the site still serves them.
Share of offerings with a plan, by period:

```{r}
#| label: coverage-by-period
df |>
  mutate(Period = cut(year, c(-Inf, 2014, 2017, 2019, 2021, 2023, Inf),
                      labels = c("–2014", "2015–17", "2018–19", "2020–21",
                                 "2022–23", "2024–"))) |>
  group_by(Institution = institution, Period) |>
  summarise(pct = sprintf("%.0f%%", mean(has_extracted_text) * 100), .groups = "drop") |>
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = Period, values_from = pct, values_fill = "", names_sort = TRUE) |>
  knitr::kable()
```

## Semester registration in DBH

DBH lists most courses under both spring and autumn of a year, also when the
course is taught, and its plan published, in one semester only. How this shows
up depends on the website:

- **Semester-specific pages** (HiOF, Hivolda, NIH, NLA, UiA, USN): the other
  semester has no page (a 404, or no USN version), so about half of the rows
  lack text by design.
- **One page per course or year**: both rows get the same page, and
  deduplication collapses them.

The row-level **Rate** in the overview therefore understates coverage for the
first group. To compare institutions, count course-years (code × year) that have
a plan in at least one semester:

```{r}
#| label: semester-registration
course_years <- df |>
  group_by(institution, course_code_raw, year) |>
  summarise(both = n_distinct(semester_name) == 2,
            n_plan = sum(!is.na(plan_content_id)), .groups = "drop")

course_years |>
  group_by(Institution = institution) |>
  summarise(
    `Course-years` = n(),
    `Both semesters in DBH` = sprintf("%.0f%%", mean(both) * 100),
    `Both reg., plan in one` = sum(both & n_plan == 1),
    `Both reg., plan in both` = sum(both & n_plan == 2),
    `Both reg., no plan` = sum(both & n_plan == 0),
    `Course-years with plan` = sprintf("%.0f%%", mean(n_plan > 0) * 100),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  left_join(select(summary_tbl, Institution, `Row rate` = Rate), by = "Institution") |>
  knitr::kable()
```

## Course-years without a plan

Why a course-year (code × year) has no plan in any semester, from
`data/interim/plan_gaps.RDS` (target `gaps`, `plan_gaps()` in
`R/pipeline.R`). **No URL**: the site has no page for that year, or URL
discovery found none (hivolda, uit, usn). **404**: the page was not found.
**Fetch error**: another error (ntnu's "no information" pages, uib).
**Page, no plan**: a page shell, a page that is not the plan, or a year
missing from NLA's JSON. **No page**: a current site without a harvest in
that year. **Between plans**: the course has a plan the year before and the
year after, so the gap is the likeliest to be a wrong URL or a missed page;
these are the ones to check by hand (`url_tried`, and `url_next_door`, the
page of an adjacent year that worked).

```{r}
#| label: plan-gaps
gaps <- readRDS("interim/plan_gaps.RDS")
gaps |>
  filter(!has_plan) |>
  group_by(Institution = institution) |>
  summarise(
    `Without plan` = n(),
    `404` = sum(grepl("404", reason)),
    `No URL` = sum(grepl("no URL", reason)),
    `Fetch error` = sum(grepl("fetch error", reason)),
    `Page, no plan` = sum(grepl("page, no plan", reason)),
    `No page` = sum(reason == "no page"),
    `Between plans` = sum(between_plans),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  knitr::kable()
```

To list the gaps between plans:
`readRDS("data/interim/plan_gaps.RDS") |> dplyr::filter(between_plans)`.

Checked 2026-10-07 and 2026-10-08, all 208 gaps between plans: one
was a wrong URL, UiT's ENG-2980 spring 2017 (an English twin, see UiT),
so 207 remain. The 404s at HiOF (11 of 12 URLs; the twelfth is now an empty
page), HVL (5 of 5, soft 404) and NIH (4 of 4) are still 404. No URL means
the site has no page for that year: UiT's semester picker has no option for it
(all 49; UiT's other 3 are pages without a plan), USN shows another year's plan for every version number
(all 30, both semesters), and Hivolda's course page lists no version for it
(all 10, mostly 2024). NTNU's 3 (2010) still say "Det finnes ingen informasjon
for dette studieåret"; INN's 7 show a later plan version. UiA's 91 are
its autumn-2023 page shells (see UiA), and REL410 2024 is registered in spring
while UiA publishes it under autumn (the only such case among UiA's 74
course-years since 2020 that are 404).

## Interpreting the dedup ratio

High dedup (>40%) is expected for current-year-only institutions where DBH registers courses for both semesters but only one plan page exists (see "Semester registration in DBH").

Low dedup (<10%) means most rows have genuinely different content, typically because plans change between years/versions (HiOF, USN) or each row is truly distinct (NIH, Steiner, UiO).

## robots.txt

The robots.txt of every host the harvests request, and of the new institutions' sites, was read on 2026-10-16; `data/robots_txt.csv` has the date, the crawl delay and the disallowed paths that touch course plans per host. The rules for all user agents apply: no robots.txt names the harvest's user agent.

- **Crawl delay.** NTNU asks for 10 seconds between requests and USN for 5, which the harvest waits (`request_delay`; USN's resolver waited 2 seconds before 2026-10-16). UiB is harvested at 10 seconds since 2026-09-30, although its robots.txt asks this only of one crawler (Scrapy) on 2026-10-16. BI's course information site (programmeinfo.bi.no) asks for 10 seconds
- **Disallowed paths the harvests used.** Two sources of plans in the harvests up to 2026-10 are paths robots.txt disallows for all user agents: UiS's PDF archive on `www6.uis.no` (see UiS) and Steiner's subject PDFs under `/dokumenter/` (see Steiner). No other path the harvests request is disallowed. Since 2026-10-17 the harvest does not request a disallowed path unless a permission is recorded in the config: no institution has granted one (the project asks UiS); Steiner's PDFs are fetched by the project lead's decision of 2026-10-19 (open data, five files), not by Steiner's permission, and a host whose robots.txt has not been read stops the harvest. At the new institutions' sites robots.txt disallows only the CMS's own paths, search and staff pages, except that BI's main site disallows PDF and Word files: a BI plan published as such a file would not be harvested

## Per-Institution Notes

Figures are in the tables above; the notes say why.

---

### HiOF (Ostfold University College)

- A plan sits in a faculty or department folder that DBH does not give, and a course no longer taught moves to `historiske-emner/` (README "Institution-Specific Notes"); since 2026-10-21 `resolve_urls_hiof_batch()` reads the folder listings of the harvested years, where before only the teacher-education folders were built (11 of the 2026-10-17 pilot's 100 course-years had a page). The selector lists fallbacks for the old and new page layouts
- Needs a browser-like user agent (`user_agent = "browser"`) to avoid 403s
- Most rows without a plan are the other semester of a course registered in both (see "Semester registration in DBH")
- Reading lists are part of the plan text; `.anon_hiof()` removes only the "Litteraturlista er sist oppdatert" line

---

### Hivolda (Volda University College)

- Semester-specific pages have numeric ids (e.g. `/emne/MGL5-10NO2B/12177`) that metadata cannot give; `resolve_urls_hivolda_batch()` reads them from the course's base page, matching "Haust" to "Høst"
- Rows without a plan are mostly semesters in which the course was not taught
- All DBH courses since 2000 were harvested 2026-10-20. The course pages list versions from autumn 2015 on, so none of the 6,326 course-years before 2015 has a plan (3,981 of them are codes with no page on the site), nor has spring 2015. In 2016–2025, 4,769 of 5,830 course-years have a plan (82%); of the rest, 162 are codes with no page and 899 are pages that list no version for that year

---

### HVL (Western Norway University of Applied Sciences)

- A page that says the plan is only in English (a shell) is fetched from the English site instead (`english_page` in the config): "Emnebeskrivelsen finnes kun på engelsk" since 2026-10-14; "Dette emnet er kun beskrevet på engelsk", "Dette emnet er berre skildra på engelsk" and "Se engelske nettsider for mer informasjon" since 2026-10-17 (English-taught master's courses of 2025 in the pilot sample: ADA512, BI4-301, MAS538, MMO5010; their 7 offerings, whose pointer had counted as a plan, were fetched again that day and got the English plan). The retry harvest of 2026-10-15 gave all 86 offerings with such a page and no plan an English plan (46 plans, mostly the English subject modules MGBEN and MGUEN); their English headings map like the Norwegian ones. The 5 MGBPE201E offerings of 2023-2025 were not retried, since their pointer had counted as a plan; a second retry harvest the same day gave them their English plan (3 plans)
- Year in the URL: the academic year the page is for (`/2025/` is "Emneplan for studieåret 2025/2026"), so a spring offering reads the year before (since 2026-10-14; until then it read the next study year's plan). 42 of the 162 spring 2020 offerings have no plan: HVL has no 2019/20 page for them ("Vi kunne ikkje finne emnet du ser etter" in every harvest up to 2026-10-15); 39 of them had read 2020/21's plan before. Soft-404 "course not found" pages are detected at fetch time (`fetch_html_cols_single_hvl()`) and stored as no HTML
- Read from `div.l-body`: the title, the facts aside (credits, campus, semesters, language, programmes) and the plan; not the year stamp and links, and from the aside not the course coordinators (names), the semester's exam schedule and the reading-list button

---

### INN (Inland Norway University of Applied Sciences)

- No plans before 2022: INN's site starts in 2022, so the URL builder returns NA for earlier years
- Some pages are the course search page ("Emnesøket gjelder kun fra ...") instead of a plan; the anonymizer turns them into NA
- Some courses are published in both Norwegian and English
- Where the requested semester has no version, the page shows the latest one, mostly with the notice "Emnebeskrivelsen for valgt semester er ikke publisert enda. Her er den siste versjonen vi har tilgjengelig.", sometimes without it (2MNK172-2 and 2MNK172S-2 spring 2022 to spring 2025 show the version from autumn 2025; INN3024-1 in 2023 "Teaching semester 2027 Spring"). Where the version's start semester (the selected "Startsemestre", `page_term`) is after the offering's semester, the offering gets no plan: 1,151 offerings, 388 of the 407 from 2022 (since 2026-10-20; before, the notice alone decided, and briefly the academic year, which kept a version starting the spring after an autumn offering: 15 offerings, 2023-2025). The banner "Statusmelding / Kun tilgjengelig på engelsk" (or "Kun tilgjengelig på" with the language left out, 26 pages) over a plan published in English only is cut as site boilerplate (since 2026-10-20). The April 2026 harvest shows the same notice on the same pages

---

### MF (MF Norwegian School of Theology)

- Only the plan in force is published (`plan_years = "current"`; see "Year coverage"). Selector `article .content-body`: the title and code, the facts box (credits, semester, language, programmes; without its buttons) and the plan; the title and facts box are in no section
- `.anon_mf()` cuts from "Emneansvarlig" to the end (names, contact details, marketing)
- The reading list is on a separate page; the plan holds only a link and a library notice, which `.anon_mf()` removes, so MF plans have no `reading_list` section
- Some course pages are closed to the public and answer HTTP 403 to every user agent, a browser's too (access-restricted Drupal nodes: the PHI courses, such as PHI2030 and PHI2115, on 2026-10-17): outcome `forbidden`, no plan, not fetched again by `retry = TRUE`

---

### NIH (Norwegian School of Sport Sciences)

- Short year range. Most 404s are the other semester of a course registered in both (see "Semester registration in DBH")
- Pages exist by year folder, `/studier/emner/{year}/{host|var}/{code}.html`, and the site publishes them for few courses before 2025. The year indexes (`/studier/emner/{year}/{host|var}/`, read 2026-10-21) list 5 pages for 2021 (teacher education, LKI), 22 for 2022 (LKI, and FRI100, FRI101, IDR107, IDR111, IDR113, SPM100, TI100) and 163 for 2025 (both semesters). Every 404 of the pilot sample's 2021 and 2022 course-years is a course the index of that year does not list (2021: 33 of 33 course-years, 2022: 31 of 33), so NIH has no page for them; the code form is not the cause (`/studier/emner/faf314.html` is 404 too). The pilot sample's 2025 404s are the other semester of a course registered in both, and the codes with Norwegian letters: the page of KRØ100 is `kro100.html`, which the harvest requested as `krø100.html` until 2026-10-21 (`add_course_url_nih()` now writes ø as o)
- Codes with a space or hyphen that are not course codes (MAS- ESSAY, UTV-ESSAY, essays on the master's programmes) have no page in any year
- Read from `#vrtx-fs-emne-content`: the title, the facts list (credits, department, semester, duration, language) and the plan; not the course coordinator, the table of contents' heading and the FS fetch stamp

---

### NLA (NLA University College)

- All DBH years (`plan_years = "url"`): a page per course and academic year, `/emneplan/{CODE}/{YYYY-YYYY}` (autumn 2024 and spring 2025 → 2024-2025), whose embedded JSON holds the plan of that year only; the json block reader (`R/blocks.R`) takes the year of the row
- Harvests until 2026-10-17 fetched one page per course code, the URL of its first offering, and gave it to every year of the course. In release data-2026-10-16, 1,554 of NLA's 2,074 teacher-ed offerings have another year's page and so no plan (a plan for 2-8 % of the course-years 2018-2023), and 271 carry the HTTP 404 of the one URL requested for their course. Their own pages are fetched by a retry (`harvest_all(retry = c(RETRY_OUTCOMES, "not_found"))`: the 404 was recorded at URLs never requested); the pilot sample's 125 were fetched on 2026-10-17 (61 plans, 42 not found, 22 pages of another year), and the other 1,811 teacher-ed offerings the same day (998 URLs: 1,459 plans, 271 not found, 81 pages of another year; teacher-ed offerings with a plan 263 → 1,722)
- For a year it has no plan for, the site answers the year's URL with another year's plan (the JSON names the year), which gives the offering no plan: 22 of the 125 pages fetched on 2026-10-17, 14 of them spring 2017 (2016-2017: no NLA page in the raw store holds that year). So a row with a page but no plan has another year's page: the site's answer, or a harvest until 2026-10-17 not yet fetched again
- The `/studietilbud/emner/` URLs are rendered in the browser, so the harvest uses `/for-studenter/Studie-%20og%20emneplaner/emneplan/{CODE}/{YYYY-YYYY}`
- Courses taught in English (the Global Journalism master's, GJ and IKF codes) have a plan with English headings, the same JSON fields as the Norwegian ones. Since 2026-10-21 they map like the Norwegian ones ("Introduction" course content, "Teaching and learning methods" and "Practice" teaching methods, "Final assessment" assessment, "Syllabus" the reading list, as "Pensum"); before, their 14 plans (none in the teacher-education frame) had no teaching methods and lost the introduction, the final assessment and the syllabus. "Scope", "Course evaluation", "Relevance within study programme", "Credit reductions", "Incompatible courses" and "Other rules" map to nothing, as their Norwegian headings do

---

### NMBU (Norwegian University of Life Sciences)

- Only the plan in force is published (`plan_years = "current"`; see "Year coverage"); few course codes. Rows without a plan are 404s for discontinued courses, or spring 2025 offerings

---

### Nord (Nord University)

- Year and semester in the URL, with Norwegian characters (`HØST`/`VÅR`); ASCII `HOEST` falls back to a generic page without year-specific content
- For a year it has no plan for, the page shows the current plan, headed "Gjeldende emnebeskrivelse (sist oppdatert 2026/27)" instead of "Emnebeskrivelse for 2023/24". Where the year it names is after the offering's academic year, the offering gets no plan (since 2026-10-14): all offerings of 2016-2018 and 205 later ones, 761 in all. Where it is not, the page is the version in force that year
- A course taught in English (2025 in the pilot sample: BIO5023, BIO5031, BIO5036) has a Norwegian page with only the title, facts and "Emnet foregår på engelsk. Se engelske nettsider ved å velge engelsk språk." (a shell); since 2026-10-17 the English page of the same year and semester is fetched instead (`/en/studies/courses/{code}?year=…&semester=…`, `english_page` in the config). It has the same accordions with English headings, and its year stamp ("Course description for 2025/26", "Current active course description (last updated 2026/27)") is read like the Norwegian one. The 3 pilot offerings were fetched again that day and got the English plan
- Accordion pages, read with a multi-element selector
- Read from `div.node__content`: the plan and the sidebar's facts (language, credits, faculty, campus) after it, in no section; not the sidebar's semester picker, staff and Leganto link
- The arbeidskrav and compulsory attendance are mostly lines inside the assessment text ("Arbeidskrav (AK): …", "OD: Obligatorisk deltakelse …", "To arbeidskrav.", "Coursework requirements:"); they move to coursework requirements (`section_inline_coursework`; abbreviations, number words and English since 2026-10-21). "Arbeidskrav og hjemmeeksamen (3 dager)" stays in assessment and is copied. Gate lines under Læringsaktiviteter stay in teaching methods (MET2000 spring 2022's "Arbeidskrav:" block, SYK5026 autumn 2025's OD and AK paragraphs)

---

### NTNU (Norwegian University of Science and Technology)

- Year in the URL, no semester: the academic year the page is for (`/2025` is "Studieår 2025/2026"), so a spring or summer offering reads the year before (since 2026-10-14; until then it read the next study year's plan). The site has no plans before 2007/08 ("Det finnes ingen informasjon for dette studieåret"), so the 150 spring and summer 2007 offerings, which read 2006/07, have none; 147 of them had read 2007/08's plan before. DBH's "-A" codes (MGLU1101-A, the primary teacher courses) are fetched without the suffix; with it the site has no page. Pages saying no information is available raise `ntnu_no_info_error`; robots.txt asks for a 10-second crawl delay
- The exam tab (FS's exam registration: assessment form, grading scale, and per exam session the exam parts with weight, duration and permitted aids) is in `course_plan` without dates, times, rooms and comments; the assessment section and the plan id keep one session of it (`exam_sessions`). The timetable tab (from 2025) is not read. `.anon_ntnu()` removes the contact block (course coordinator, teachers); the responsible unit stays, and the dedup hash ignores it
- The arbeidskrav are listed under "Mer om vurdering" ("OBLIGATORISKE ARBEIDSKRAV", "Obligatoriske aktiviteter:"), often with only "Obligatoriske arbeidskrav iht. emnebeskrivelsen" under the coursework heading; since 2026-10-20 the block moves from the assessment section to coursework requirements (`section_inline_coursework`). Arbeidskrav and "Vurderingsform:" lines under Læringsformer stay in teaching methods (52 and 19 sections)
- A course whose plan is only in English (master's courses at Gjøvik in the pilot sample: IMT4127 2022, IMT4312 2025, MACS490 2025, SMF1081 spring 2022) has a Norwegian page whose course content, and mostly every other part, says only "See English version.", "Se engelsk beskrivelse." or "Se engelsk tekst."; since 2026-10-19 the English page on www.ntnu.edu is fetched instead (`english_page` in the config), with the same layout and English headings. Such a page fetched before gives no plan, though its exam tab would make it one. The 7 pilot offerings were fetched again on 2026-10-19 and got the English plan, as did GEOG2500 spring 2022, autumn 2022 and spring 2023 (3 teacher-education offerings), whose course content says only "Se engelsk tekst."
- The spring and autumn offerings of a year read the same page, fetched at different times. Between the fetches NTNU reworded the stock credit-overlap note ("Dette emne har …" / "Dette emnet har …") and changed programme lists, so 555 pages gave two plans until 2026-10-13. The admission programme list, the credit-reduction box and the subject areas are now outside the plan id, and the banners ("Nytt fra studieåret …", "Undervises ikke studieåret …") are not read

---

### OsloMet (Oslo Metropolitan University)

- The URL always uses `HØST`: spring URLs return 404. `/{YEAR}/HØST` is the plan of study year YEAR/YEAR+1, so a spring offering reads YEAR-1 (since 2026-10-14). Pattern: `https://student.oslomet.no/studier/-/studieinfo/emne/{CODE}/{YEAR}/HØST`
- Re-harvested 2026-02-14 after the site moved to server-side rendering. Error pages ("Siden du leter etter finnes ikke") become NA in the anonymizer
- `.anon_oslomet()` removes the "Emneansvarlig" block whole, up to "Emneoverlapp" or the end of the page: it holds one or more names, with a title, a part ("Delemne …: <name>") or a role ("… coordinator: professor <name>") (since 2026-10-17)
- **Practicum courses whose sections only say "Se fagplanen." have no sections** (M1GP\*/M5GP\*, 132 of 248 offerings with a plan on 2026-10-15; the others have text of their own and get its sections). The page's "Fagplan" block is the programme-wide practicum plan for all study years, with no markup separating the years, so it is not read into the course's sections. Their `course_plan` keeps the full page text

---

### Samas (Sámi University of Applied Sciences)

- `noop` strategy, no plans: the website's course codes (SÁM-1005, DUO-1014, ...) do not correspond to DBH codes (V1SAM-1100-1, ...), and the V1/V5 teacher education courses appear only in programme PDFs without per-course descriptions

---

### Steiner (Rudolf Steiner University College)

- Only the plan in force is published (`plan_years = "current"`; see "Year coverage"). Plans come from five subject PDFs at `steinerhoyskolen.no`, split by course heading; the PDFs are not stored, so the split text is the raw data
- The site's robots.txt (read 2026-10-16) disallows `/dokumenter/`, where the five PDFs are, for all user agents. Every Steiner plan comes from that path. Since 2026-10-19 they are fetched by the project lead's decision (open data, five files, negligible traffic), not by a permission from Steiner, which was not asked (`robots_permission` in the config)
- The five PDFs are those of the bachelor Steinerpedagogisk lærerutdanning: they cover 15 emner of five subjects, which the course names of that programme and of the 1-7 teacher programme (M- codes) match. Of DBH 2025's 125 Steiner course codes (106 without the emne suffix, 244 offerings), the all-courses harvest of 2026-10-19 (2026/27, which joins DBH 2026) found a plan for 30 (60 offerings). The others have no source: the kindergarten teacher programmes, the master in Waldorf education, social pedagogy, further education, the practicum modules (M-LP1/2/3, BDP, BLP, DLP) and the bachelor theses. Until DBH has 2026, Steiner's plans are the 15 offerings of the 2026-04-04 harvest (2025/26)
- M-PEL2.1/M-PEL2.2 get the PDF's PEL1.4/PEL1.5 plans (`.steiner_remap_pel_emne()`), and since 2026-10-19 the bachelor's PEL1.4/PEL1.5 too; the M-PEL2 match is to be confirmed against the programme description

---

### UiA (University of Agder)

- The site has plans from 2020 on; earlier years return 404
- DBH registers most courses in both semesters, but UiA publishes one page, so most 404s are the other semester (see "Semester registration in DBH")
- Autumn 2023: 95 pages are shells (title and facts box, no plan), so 91 course-years have no plan between two that do. They are courses UiA now teaches in spring (94 pages say "Undervisningssemester: Vår"). Every copy UiA has rebuilt from FS since (2026-09-30, 10-06 and 10-08, by the page's "Sist hentet fra FS") is a shell, the English pages too; the full pages seen at 13:40 on 2026-10-07 were old copies, last fetched from FS in July 2024. The site no longer has these plans, so the offerings stay without one
- URL pattern: `https://www.uia.no/studier/emner/{year}/{semester}/{course_code}.html`; the semester folders are `host` and `var`
- DBH's variant suffixes `-G`, `-G2` and `-D` (MA-015-G, TFL011-G2, PRA090-D) are not in the site's code: ma-015, tfl011, pra090 answer, the codes with the suffix never do (checked 2026-10-21). Until then the builder kept the suffix and the 41 such offerings in the raw store, and 37 of the pilot's, were 404. The builder now drops the suffix. A few such courses have no page under either form (IKT623, IKT454, MA-015 and others in the 2022 and 2025 pilot years, 404 in both semesters): the site does not publish them, so they stay without a plan

---

### UiB (University of Bergen)

- Year in the URL; accordion pages read with a multi-element selector; harvested at 10 seconds a page (`request_delay`, set 2026-09-30 for the crawl delay robots.txt was read to ask; on 2026-10-16 it asks it only of Scrapy, and the pace is kept)
- The page's semester picker is dropped when the HTML is parsed
- Read from `div.region-inner.grid`: the title, level and facts list (credits, semester, code, number of semesters, language) and the main column; not the sidebar (contact e-mail, the semester's exam schedule, a link to the department, so the responsible unit is not in `course_plan`)
- About 280 pages say "Vi opplever problemer med å hente inn eksamensinformasjon": UiB's exam information service fails for these courses, in every year. Fetching the 294 affected pages again on 2026-10-02 fixed 7, so it is not a harvest error. The banner is removed from the sections, and these courses have no assessment text
- 72 pages say "Inga emnebeskriving tilgjengeleg" (no plan for that semester) and give no plan; 30 of them also carry "Feil i visning av emnebeskrivelse". Fetched again on 2026-10-14, 29 still carry both and none gives a plan, so the plan is not on the site
- All courses (pilot sample of 100 course-years, 2010/2019/2022/2025): on 2026-10-17, 74 course-years answered 404 and 3 failed. Fetched again on 2026-10-21, 29 gave a page (HIS101, STAT260, PED322 among them): UiB's site sometimes answers 404 for a page it has. The other 48 have no page on UiB's site, in any semester and without `start_semester` (12 of them checked so): 25 courses DBH last lists before 2025 or as discontinued (UiB keeps no page for a course it no longer offers, even for the semesters it ran), 14 PhD courses, 4 master's theses and other milestones (JUS399, MABARN351, MEDFLMIDT, GEO310), 2 UNIS courses (AB206, AG335, on unis.no), and 3 design semester blocks whose DBH code has a space (`BAR 3`, `UTV VISK 5H`; also not as `bar3` or `bar-3`). Every course-year of the sample with a page is of a course DBH still lists in 2025

---

### UiO (University of Oslo)

- Only the plan in force is published (`plan_years = "current"`; see "Year coverage"). Semester URLs (`/h24/`, `/v25/`) hold logistics (teachers, timetable, exam dates), not the plan
- The URL holds a faculty and department folder (`https://www.uio.no/studier/emner/{faculty}/{department}/{CODE}/`), read from UiO's sitemap, which lists only the courses taught now; a course not listed gets the folder of the listed courses with its code prefix, else of its DBH department (README "Institution-Specific Notes"). On 2026-10-16, 3,689 of the 5,163 course codes active in DBH 2025 were listed. Of the 1,474 not listed (822 PhD level, 107 UNIS courses), a sample of 40 guessed URLs gave 11 pages; the rest were 404s: UNIS courses (on unis.no), PhD reading-list codes (`SP`) and odontology specialist codes have no page at UiO
- Read from `#vrtx-content`: the title, the plan and the facts box after it ("Fakta om emnet": level, credits, semesters, language, department), in no section
- `.anon_uio()` cuts the generic "Mer om eksamen ved UiO" link list, up to the facts box

---

### UiS (University of Stavanger)

- Current plans come from the course web page, older ones from the PDF archive linked in its semester dropdown (`html_pdf_discovery`); the PDFs are not stored, so their text is the raw data
- The PDF archive is on `www6.uis.no`, whose robots.txt (read 2026-10-16) disallows every path but `/ansatt/` for all user agents. The harvests up to 2026-10 fetched it: 2,201 of the 2,719 UiS offerings with a plan text (2009-2025) have it from a PDF, the other 518 from the course page on `www.uis.no`, which robots.txt allows. Since 2026-10-17 a UiS harvest does not request the PDFs (outcome `robots`) until UiS gives permission
- A dropdown entry is an academic year ("2024 - 2025"; its PDF says "studietilbudet for studieår 2024-2025"), so a spring or summer offering reads the year before (since 2026-10-14; until then it read the next academic year's plan). For a year the dropdown lacks, the course page itself is fetched. It shows the latest version, the one selected in the dropdown; where that is after the offering's academic year, the offering gets no plan (since 2026-10-14): 97 offerings, most of 2007-2018. A course page without a dropdown names no year and stays (96 offerings)
- Web pages are read from the blocks of `div.article`, without navigation and contact footer; the facts box ("Fakta": code, credits, semesters, language) is in `course_plan` without its timetable and Leganto links, and in no section

---

### UiT (The Arctic University of Norway)

- **Historical plans** via document ids from the course page's semester picker, plus the document the page itself shows (the latest; the picker leaves it out, so before 2026-10-21 the latest document of every course was missed, e.g. autumn 2025 for courses whose plan for spring 2026 was not yet published)
- Course-years without a document (pilot sample of all courses, 2026-10-21, checked on the course pages: 33 of 100 course-years, after the shown document gave 7 more their URL). UiT's documents follow the semesters a course is taught (LER-3101: every spring 2021-2026), while DBH also lists courses in years without a document:
  - The page exists but has no document for the DBH year (21): the documents stop years before (the PhD special-curriculum courses KJE-8810, MED-8815, SVF-8044: last document spring 2012, DBH 2025; PSY-3027 last spring 2021; HIF-3113 last spring 2023), start after it (2008: the earliest documents are autumn 2008, so spring 2008 has none; KJE-8897 and MED-3881 start in 2009), or skip it (SAM-1013: autumn 2024, then autumn 2026)
  - No course page at all (12): the page says "Error rendering component" for the code, also with DBH's version suffix and in lower case. These are old doctoral programme codes of 2008 (FARMDG, FILDG, SOSANTDRSP2, SOSIODRSP1), codes such as XXX-1000 and BB351, and, likely, courses discontinued before the documents begin (REL-1012, SAM-0100 in 2008)
  - AG- and AGF- codes (DBH unit "UiT (uspesifisert underenhet)", e.g. AG-323 "Sequence stratigraphy") are by their codes and titles courses of UNIS on Svalbard, which publishes its plans on its own site; UiT's pages have at most a 2012 document or none. They are not harvested
- The plan is read from `#maincontents`: the course code and title, the facts (campus, semester, credits, level) and `.mainContent` (since 2026-10; the old `.hovedfelt > main > div.col-md-12` matched nothing after a site change, so the 2026-10 harvest first had no text); not the breadcrumbs and the apply button with the application period
- `.pre_uit()` removes the "OBS! Dette emnet tilhører et tidligere semester / år" banner and cuts from "Andre år og semester" / "Kontakt oss" (staff names and e-mails) to the end; the responsible unit from the contact block ("Ansvarlig enhet", without its e-mail) stays, at the end of the text and in no section, and the plan id leaves it out
- Some pages say "Error rendering component" where the plan should be: the plan failed to render on UiT's site, and these rows have only the title and facts, a page shell without a plan
- The semester picker can list a semester twice: an English document ("Course code:", in all 5 cases an empty page) beside the Norwegian one. The Norwegian one is used; the first option was used before 2026-10-08, and a retry harvest (`harvest_all(institutions = "uit", retry = TRUE)`) gave these 5 offerings their plan

---

### USN (University of South-Eastern Norway)

- Most rows without a plan are the other semester of a course registered in both (see "Semester registration in DBH")
- The URL holds a plan version (1-3 are tried; all URLs found are 1 or 2) that metadata cannot give: `https://www.usn.no/studier/studie-og-emneplaner/#/emne/{CODE}_{VERSION}_{YEAR}_{SEMESTER}`. Invalid version/year combinations silently show another page, so `resolve_urls_usn_batch()` renders each candidate in Chrome and checks the displayed year (README "Institution-Specific Notes")
- Content is rendered in Shadow DOM and read with `read_usn_live_html()`
- A semester with no plan of its own shows another semester's plan under the banner "MERK: Emneplanen for dette semesteret er ikke klar ennå. ... viser vi derfor emneplanen fra et tidligere semester." Its displayed year is that other semester's, so no URL is kept for it. Six pages of the 2026-09 harvest (HI-MOD4000 spring 2019, HI-MIG4000 and LH-HID1200 spring 2022, LR-PRA3000 spring 2023, LRMF510 and MG1PP2 spring 2024) still carry the banner although they show the requested semester's plan. The page read before them had shown the same plan, and the site keeps the banner until the page is reloaded. Loaded again on 2026-10-13, they show the same plan text without the banner. `.cleanup_usn_text()` removes the banner, and the resolver now reloads a page that has the requested year and the banner
- A course taught in English has an English page ("Applies to: Course start autumn 2022", banner "Note: The course plan for this semester is not available yet."). Until 2026-10-21 the resolver read only "Undervisningsstart", so such a course got no URL in any semester; it now reads both. In the pilot sample (all courses, 100 course-years) this gave 12 course-years a page (46 → 58), all of them English (MAR4020 autumn 2022, MET9000 spring 2025, FEMLI20 autumn 2018, ...)
- The pilot's other 42 course-years without a page (2026-10-21, version 1 rendered in Chrome, versions 2-3 by the resolver): 21 show another semester's plan under the banner (e.g. EK5420 autumn 2022 shows autumn 2021, 4013 autumn 2025 shows spring 2024), 10 show a cohort plan from before USN ("Planen gjelder for: Kull 2017 HØST", "Class of 2014 Autumn": 3489, 9210, RET2000D and four more in 2018, SAM 501, VVL1, PHDMOD500 in 2019; no plan of USN's own), and 11 show an empty page with only the banner (no plan in any version: e.g. ALDSU122 and 9228 in 2025, STREKON1 in 2022, HRM100 and SAMH in 2018). The old numeric codes (3489, 4013, 4505, 9210, 9228) are USN's codes too; they have no plan of their own for the year
- English pages are read with the Norwegian page's rules: the facts box is cut only after "Innholdsfortegnelse", and several English headings are not in the heading map (2026-10-21: "Course is part of these studies", "Participation/Compulsory work", "Approved course plan", "Change description", "Miscellaneous", "Forms of assessment", "Compulsory Activity")
